_note: Technical Papers series. Add a paper: write _content/<slug>.md (start at '## Abstract'; no title or author lines), add an entry at the END of 'papers' with the next number, then run: python3 papers/_build.py. Never reuse a number or slug.

papers.title: Exoskeletons: History, Commercialisation, Industry Landscape and Future Outlook
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: From Yagn's 1890 spring patent and GE's Hardiman to FDA-cleared walking suits, factory shoulder vests and consumer hip-assist devices: the history, the path to market, today's major makers with links, and where each application is heading.

papers.title: Heat Sealing of LDPE, HS-BOPP, PET/LDPE, PET/MPET/LDPE and BOPP/MBOPP Laminates in Bag-Making Machines: Parameter Windows, Machine Evolution and Future Benchmarks
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: Starting jaw temperature, dwell and pressure for five common bag and pouch structures across their thickness ranges, why a PET outer layer doubles the sealing window, how bag-making machines evolved from cams to servo, today's speed benchmarks, and what recyclable mono-material films will change. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: Extended Color Gamut in Gravure Printing: History, Advantages, Colour Reduction, Alternatives and Current Trends
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: How a fixed set of seven process inks (CMYKOGV) lets gravure converters replace spot colours: the history from CMY to Hexachrome, Opaltone and today's ECG, the advantages, how it cuts colour count and ink changes, alternative schemes, limitations, an adoption roadmap and 2024–2026 trends. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: LDPE-Based Blown Films for Lamination: Historical Emergence, Process Windows, Additives and Current Trends
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: How LDPE became the sealant web of laminated packs and how it has evolved: blow-up ratio and process windows, the temperature at each station of the line, lamination-grade properties, a dedicated review of additives from metallocene PE and fillers to slip and PFAS-free processing aids, and the move to all-PE recyclable laminates. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: The Role of Tension Control in Gravure Printing: Historical Evolution, Current Methods and Guideline Tension Values from Unwind to Rewind
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: How gravure presses moved from hand-set brakes and line shafts to dancers, load cells and electronic line shafts, and starting tension values for BOPET, BOPP, CPP, PE, nylon, shrink film, foil, paper and board by thickness and web width, zone by zone from unwind to rewind taper. PDF in IEEE two-column format.
